title: Tax Setup
deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? This profile will be permanently hidden and cannot be edited.

noDefaultProfile.title: No default tax profile
noDefaultProfile.description: Orders are taxed only by tax profiles. Without an active default profile, new orders carry no tax. Add a profile and set it as default.

rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.hint: Leave empty to use the currency's own decimals and increment. Applies to new orders.

engine.description: Your organization's tax setup: registration, tax codes and rules.

readiness.TAX_RATE_MISSING: A tax code has no rate yet. Enter it above.
readiness.TAX_NO_SALES_RULE: There is no tax rule for sales. Apply a tax kit again or add a rule.
readiness.TAX_REGISTRATION_MISSING: A registration number is missing. Enter one for the organization or for every branch.
readiness.TAX_EMIRATE_MISSING: A UAE branch has no emirate. Choose it above.
readiness.TAX_PRODUCT_CLASS_MISSING: Some products have no tax class. Apply the tax kit again to give them the default class.

registrations.title: Tax registration numbers
registrations.hint: A branch without its own number uses the organization's number.

overview.title: Tax setup
overview.noKit: Choose a tax kit to start. Contact support if none is offered for your country.
overview.pendingTitle: Tax setup is waiting for confirmation
overview.pending: Review the setup and confirm it.
overview.pendingContact: Ask someone who manages tax settings to review and confirm it.
overview.enabledHint: Turn off only if your organization stops charging tax.
overview.advancedHint: Shows tax codes, rules and item classes. You cannot return to Basic while your own rules or classes are active.
overview.changeKitHint: Replaces the waiting setup. Rows you changed are kept and listed for review.
overview.changeKitActiveHint: Your setup is active, so applying a kit also activates it. Rows you changed are kept and listed for review.
overview.applyBody: The setup stays waiting for confirmation. Orders are not affected.
overview.applyBodyActive: This changes your active tax setup right away, if everything required is in place.

review.title: Review tax setup
review.description: Check that this is right for your business, then confirm it.
